how.text: official pricing pages first, then trackers. A change is reported only when the checked value differs from the baseline in data/prices.json.
how.title: Daily check:

how.text: changed = report + update baseline after the report is confirmed sent; unchanged = silent, no write; unknown = check failed / no data — recorded as “not verified”, never stamped unchanged.
how.title: Three states:

how.text: apply a result only if its check time is newer than that provider's watermark, so a late older result never rolls the baseline back.
how.title: Watermark:

how.text: never report a deal from a coupon site alone — verify on the provider's own page or a dated official announcement.

Go.codex: Trial / limited Codex; may include ads

Plus.codex: Included - expanded usage (web, CLI, IDE, iOS)
Plus.notes: Cheapest: Philippines PHP 999 ~$15.63/mo (App Store). App Store annual ~17% off exists.

Pro.codex: 5x / 20x Codex usage vs Plus; Pro 500 adds Ultrafast; monthly API credits equal to tier price
Pro.notes: No cheaper country found - USD-priced everywhere checked

Google AI Plus.notes: 2 TB storage. Cheapest: Bolivia BOB 34.99 ~$2.99/mo web; Turkey TRY 199.99 ~$3.95 App Store

Google AI Pro.notes: Gemini 4 Neon/Hydrogen, Deep Research, 5 TB storage, YouTube Premium Lite, Gemini in Gmail/Docs, $10/mo Google Cloud credits. Cheapest: Bolivia Bs 139.99 ~$11.97/mo web; Brazil R$96.90 ~$16.26 App Store

Google AI Ultra.notes: Excluded from Black Friday deal. No cheaper country found

AI Expanded Access add-on.gemini: Argon model, up to 200 prompts/day; Standard and above only, not Starter

Business Plus.notes: Adds Vault, 5 TB storage, bigger Meet

Business Standard.gemini: Pro model up to 25 prompts/4h; Thinking up to 80/4h; 1M context; Gemini across Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Meet, Chat; Deep Research 5/4h; image 100/day; video up to 3/day
Business Standard.notes: Sweet spot for teams. Argon model NOT included

Business Starter.gemini: Basic Pro model, 32k context; Gemini in Gmail and Vids only (not Docs/Sheets/Slides/Drive/Meet/Chat); Deep Research 1 report/4h; image 20/day; no video
Business Starter.notes: Cap 300 users. Regional: India INR 540 ~$6.10, Thailand THB 275 ~$8.50, UK ~GBP 5.90 ~$7.90 (annual, before local tax)

Claude Pro.notes: Claude Code included. Max $100/mo, Ultra $200/mo. Cheapest: Pakistan PKR 4,900 ~$17.72/mo

Microsoft 365 Premium (Copilot).notes: Personal $9.99/mo; Family $12.99/mo. Standing 30% off first period

Perplexity Pro.notes: Max $167/mo billed annually. +$40 Computer credits, limited time
